title: Care Providers
metaDescription: Marina Harbor Detox partners with treatment programs across the Bay Area. Refer clients for safe, medically supervised detox and stay updated on their progress.

blocks.text: We encourage all of our fellow treatment programs to utilize us in any capacity deemed necessary. If you refer someone to us, trust that you will be kept apprised until your patient can return to you. It’s an honor to handle difficult detoxes, or be a place holder for our partners until an in-patient or PHP bed open up. Let us help you.
“It’s heart warming to see different facilities work together to accomplish one goal. That’s the truest example of putting the patient’s best interest first.”
Individualized Treatment to Break the Cycle

We understand the seriousness of addiction. Our treatment options range from detoxification to an intensive, inpatient psychotherapeutic program that addresses the symptoms and underlying causes of addiction. Our caring team of experts is trained to help people overcome their addiction in a safe and nurturing environment.

A cornerstone of our model and philosophy is that we believe each patient comes with an individual story and experience. Throughout the treatment process, we do everything to honor each patient’s uniqueness through a carefully tailored combination of therapies designed to unlock the greatest potential for healing and growth.

Marina Harbor provides a continuum of care that supports its clients through the process of stabilizing health & wellness, foundational sobriety and a life in recovery. Our program offers complete detox – detox alcohol and/or drugs, restoring health, restore food/nutrition, stabilize medications, and restoring clarity of mind. Our treatment programs help build a recovery foundation with each client based on their needs. At the transitional level, the client recovers their life. For some, they may be ready to get back to recovery meetings, return home with some additional accountability measures. For others, our highly connected drug and alcohol counselors will begin a referral process to the next stage in treatment, whatever that may be.Our treatment team provides each client with a comprehensive discharge plan that will include referrals from a network of providers based on the client’s individual needs.Our Alumni Program offers virtual support on social media networks and also through local and international events & meetings.Follow up contact support encourages accountability and supports integration progress. Staff will follow up with each discharging client for support.
